Subject: Request: H200 swap + temporary burst & overage cadence for EdgeLabs renewal

Team —

EdgeLabs (renewal due 06/01) just surfaced a last-minute change: their engineering lead confirmed the new models require H200 inference for the next 8–10 weeks to validate latency at peak traffic. They want the dedicated reservation we quoted (12x H100) to be temporarily served on H200 for the first 8 weeks, plus a predictable burst window for a known daily rehearsal period.

Quick summary of ask (from Samir):
- Temporary hardware swap: serve first 8 weeks on H200 (12 reserved equivalents) instead of H100
- Burst: allow up to +2 H200 equivalent capacity for up to 6 hours/day for the first 4 weeks, extendable by mutual agreement
- Overage cadence: reduce overage multiplier from standard 1.6x to 1.25x for the first 3 billing cycles during the swap period
- Reservation hold: allow a 6-week pause (no termination) if their onboarding fails final certs, with crediting applied to the remainder of the term

Why this matters: they sign on as a reference customer for our new low-latency inference profile if we can meet these constraints; losing the swap likely delays the whole deal and risks them moving to a competitor for this validation.

Requested approvals:
- Permission to grant nonstandard hardware routing (H200 instead of H100) for 8 weeks
- Temporary discounted overage rate (1.25x) for 3 cycles
- Short-term burst allowance with no penalty for scheduled peaks (documented schedule)
- Reservation hold clause for up to 6 weeks

Attachments: edge_quote_v3.pdf (proposal with pricing), capacity_plan.xlsx (customer's expected daily traffic windows)

Asking for a Yes/No or clarifying question by EOD; Samir is on a procurement path and would like formal language for DS/contract addendum.

Thanks —
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
SaaS Sales, Redwood Inference
